description: YouCam Mobile is a fun, touch-optimized video and photo software for Windows® 8 PCs. Capture videos and photos on tablets and choose from a wide selection of amazing and cool effects to spice them up. YouCam Mobile features various camera shooting modes, including panorama, smile shot and timer, to best capture your precious moments. Its intuitive, finger gesture functionality allows you to easily edit your photos – from rotating, cropping and even adding color presets!
